description: This file provides wrapper functions around custom memory allocation routines (mlt_malloc, mlt_free, etc.) which include tracking the return address for debugging purposes. The functions are conditionally compiled based on the USE_SYSRES_MLT macro, indicating they are part of a memory resource management toolset.

methods.name: void * rpl_malloc0(unsigned int size,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Allocates memory of given size, logs calling function, file, and line number.

methods.name: void * rpl_malloc1(unsigned int size,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Allocates memory of given size, logs caller at a different stack level, along with file and line info.

methods.name: void rpl_free0(void * p,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Frees memory, logs calling function, file, and line number.

methods.name: void rpl_free1(void * p,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Frees memory with caller logged at a different stack level, along with file and line info.

methods.name: void * rpl_realloc0(void * p,unsigned int size,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Reallocates memory to new size, with caller info.

methods.name: void * rpl_realloc1(void * p,unsigned int size,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Reallocates memory with caller info from a different stack level.

methods.name: void * rpl_calloc0(unsigned int num,unsigned int size,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for array, with caller info.

methods.name: void * rpl_calloc1(unsigned int num,unsigned int size,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Same as above, with caller info from a different stack level.

methods.name: char * rpl_strdup(const char * str,const char * file,int line)
methods.description: Duplicates a string, with caller info.
